text: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of a Council Member to fill a vacancy on the Board of Health, resulting from the resignation of Councillor Parthi Kandavel from the Board.

The Striking Committee referred the item to the City Clerk and directed the City Clerk to conduct a new canvass of Members of Council for their interest in membership on the Board of Health, and bring it forward to the next meeting of the Striking Committee.
